video_title: Channing REFUSES To Call Kawhi a Top 25 Player... Perk LOSES It

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues Kawhi Leonard is a top 25 player
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi moves the needle. We are talking about a top 25 greatest player of all time.
quotes.quote: Kawhi moves the needle. We are talking about a top 25 greatest player of all time. When you go and look at Kawhi's resume, it is longer than a CVS receipt. Two-time Finals MVP. That one Finals MVP says enough on the floor with Tim Duncan, Manu Ginobili, or whoever. He moves the needle. Even at 35, coming off the best regular season of his career and still one of the best closers in the game with Scottie Barnes and RJ Barrett.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson questions using Kawhi Leonard's past resume for current impact
quotes.excerpt: We don't have to give a person's resume to talk about their impact tomorrow.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: When he was 23 years old, he is 35 years old with multiple knee surgeries. We don't have to give a person's resume to talk about their impact tomorrow on the Toronto Raptors.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: No, but what I am saying is he moves the needle. I am not saying he is a top 25 player of all time.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins analyzes the current state of the Knicks and Celtics
quotes.excerpt: The East is a bit dysfunctional right now.
quotes.quote: The East is a bit dysfunctional right now. We are watching the Knicks, they just lost a huge piece in Mitchell Robinson. They got a void to fill. We don't know what is going on with the Boston Celtics, they just lost Vucevic. Yeah, they signed Mike Conley, but did that really take them over the top? What the hell is going on in Detroit? It is a lot of what-ifs.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins discuss the Clippers' wing defenders
quotes.excerpt: They got two wing defenders now. Two of them are monsters.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: They got two wing defenders now. Two of them are monsters.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Yeah, and they can play that Scottie Barnes pick-and-roll and go guard your point guard and disrupt him, but it is unusually tall with long arms. That is ridiculous. So when I look at Toronto, especially when I say, man, y'all was on the cusp and Brandon Ingram had a bad showing, that is scary.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins debate if Brandon Ingram equates to winning
quotes.excerpt: Does having Brandon Ingram on your team equate to winning it?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Does having Brandon Ingram on your team equate to winning it? In his career, I just don't.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Well, this year, it was Scottie Barnes. No, but Scottie Barnes wasn't the sole reason.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins notes the playoffs are a different game
quotes.excerpt: The playoffs is a different game, y'all know this.
quotes.quote: The playoffs is a different game, y'all know this. Prior to this, I would have told y'all leave Brandon Ingram alone. This man cold, I have watched plenty film on him, blah, blah, blah. Seeing that in the playoffs threw me off. When people cannot make adjustments in the playoffs, it throws me off.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins evaluates Kawhi Leonard's performance with the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: I watched Kawhi with the Pelicans average 30 against Chris Paul in the series.
quotes.quote: I watched Kawhi with the Pelicans average 30 against Chris Paul in the series. Literally with no Zion Williamson, he was like handling his business. Now the one thing that y'all all know and we all know is sometimes a change of scenery, and I am not discrediting the coaching in Toronto, Coach Darko, because I knew Darko when he was young in Oklahoma City when he first got started. I love what he is doing with that organization. But Brandon Ingram getting put with Ty Lue might be the thing that he needs.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye does not consider Kawhi Leonard a top 25 player
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Kawhi Leonard is a top 25 player.
quotes.quote: I don't think Kawhi Leonard is a top 25 player. I think his body of work, as a player, he is one of the best, as the idea of him. But you look at how many available years he has had to play.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye and Kendrick Perkins discuss Kawhi Leonard's availability
quotes.excerpt: If he did it in less time, I'm saying he did it without playing as much.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: If he did it in less time, I'm saying he did it without playing as much.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: He is still up there. I just have to give the credit to somebody. If somebody plays 17 years and they are a nine-time All-Star, they should have way more stuff than Kawhi Leonard. But why does he have more and he didn't play as much? Because he is that fucking good.
